column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the high places of antiquity” is rendered “The ancient heights.”
Close to the Hebrew; “crush you” is rendered “swallowed you up,” and “the whispering of the people” “slandered by the people.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the ravines” is rendered “the rivers.”
Close to the Hebrew; “with scorn of soul” is rendered “spiteful minds,” and “so that its pasture becomes spoil” “in order to plunder its open country.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the ravines” is rendered “the rivers,” and “the insults of the nations” “the shame of the nations.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I lift up my hand” is rendered “I have raised My hand in an oath.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I am with you” (or “toward you”) is rendered “I am for you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will be fruitful” is rendered “bear young.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your nations” is rendered as singular, “your nation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your nations” is rendered as singular, “your nation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the insults of the nations” is rendered “the taunts of the nations,” and “your nations” “your nation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the uncleanness of menstruation” is rendered “the uncleanness of a woman in her customary impurity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I showed pity on my holy name” is rendered “I had concern for My holy name.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will bring it about that you walk in my statutes” is rendered “cause you to walk in My statutes.”
